integrity: The result is accompanied by an explicit proof and independently scripted finite cross-checks. No claim of independent certification is made.
scientific_limitations: Only two equivalence relations on a fixed labelled finite universe are classified; no isomorphism-class enumeration, many-agent extension, or general asymptotic is asserted. Older weakly aggregative logic and decorated-partition literature could contain broader coverage.
title: When two-agent someone-knows becomes normal: a componentwise partition criterion and exact census
